title: ChatQueryStreamDelta
description: chat.query.delta. A streamed query runs the same agent loop as a non-streamed one, so a turn that calls tools streams several rounds. Each round is a dispatch: a new dispatchId starts a new round, and its reply starts over. Text before a tool call is interim; the turn's answer is the last round's, as in POST /v1/chat/query.

dispatchId.description: The round's dispatch. It changes when a new round starts.

delta.description: The text this frame adds to the round.

reply.description: The current round's text so far.
